task.ques: Locate the course 'Modern Art & Ideas' on Coursera offered by The Museum of Modern Art. Find out the percentage (rounded) of 3-star ratings in the reviews and note which star level has the lowest percentage.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: For Modern Art & Ideas by The Museum of Modern Art, 3-star ratings account for 2% (rounded from 2.42%). The lowest percentage is 2-star ratings at 0.63% (1-star: 0.65%).
Source: https://www.coursera.org/learn/modern-art-ideas/reviews — Overall rating breakdown, viewed October 27, 2026. All Learners, All Stars; default sort: Most Helpful; no date filter applied.
Evidence: final.png.
